## ✨ Added

- New `ELEMENT_EXTRA_FEATURES` environment variable: a JSON object merged into Element Web's `features` block (labs/feature flags) at render time, e.g. `ELEMENT_EXTRA_FEATURES={"feature_html_topic": true}` to enable Markdown/HTML room topics (MSC3765). Previously the `features` block was hardcoded empty and rewritten on every start, so no labs flag could be enabled persistently. Invalid JSON is detected and dropped with a warning in the container log instead of shipping a broken `config.json` that would fail Element Web entirely. Requested in [#27](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/matrix/issues/27).
